drafts.summary: Define Tier Zero within a Scope Unit
drafts.body:
## Summary

Define Tier Zero within a Scope Unit

## Claim

### Prose Claim

Tier `0` Atoms define their own Scope Unit internally. The Atom's Role and Form remain distinct from its Tier. A Solution, Direct Policy, Approach Policy or Decision has no fixed Tier solely because of that Form. Applicable numeric Tier and governing-Relation constraints continue to apply.
dependencies: admit proposed Forms before applying their named Form conditions
drafts.identity_note: Summary changes; allocate fresh Requirement ID and retire CA-R-2424 with explicit inbound-reference disposition.
Summary unchanged; remove only Tier 0 Scope Contract label condition; preserve numeric 1–4 conditions and all other constraints.

drafts.summary: Permit local realization in Scope Units with children
drafts.body:
## Summary

Permit local realization in Scope Units with children

## Claim

### Prose Claim

A Scope Unit retains its own realization while delegating other contributions to descendants. Its own realization includes applicable code, tests, integration and delivery.
drafts.identity_note: Fresh Rule; does not create an Implementation Atom or impose an instance/role count.

drafts.body:
## Summary

Validate Tier Zero Content-role semantics

## Claim

### Prose Claim

A Tier `0` Atom fails this Evaluation when its complete Claim’s primary contribution does not match the applicable canonical Role Declaration Semantics. Tier `0` defines the Scope Unit internally; Tier does not change the Atom’s Role or Form. This Evaluation imposes no Role- or Form-specific Tier and does not require every Role in a Scope Unit.
drafts.identity_note: Summary unchanged; retain the complete-Claim mismatch failure, use canonical Role Declaration Semantics, and remove the obsolete Scope Contract label and redundant Role definitions.

retirement.when: Only after the replacement and dependent source updates are accepted.

open_impact: Local use of SPECIALIZES and other stored governing Relations must still satisfy R2149, including the same-Tier-0 exception; no permission or new Relation is inferred.
Scope Delegation Tier and authorized allocator remain open; no Form-specific tier imposed.
R1767/R2123 Policy ownership and admissible Forms are assigned to the forms/conflicts lane; do not modify here.
